description: This file defines the SqlStoredBannerAdapter class implementing Flysystem adapter interface for handling image files stored in a database, with methods for file operations like read, write, delete, and rename, specifically for images stored via OA_Dal.

classes.name: SqlStoredBannerAdapter
classes.description: A Flysystem adapter class for database-stored images, supporting file operations like getUniqueNameForDuplication, has, read, write, delete, getSize, update, rename, copy, and throwing exceptions for unsupported stream and directory operations.

methods.name: getUniqueNameForDuplication
methods.description: Generates a unique filename for duplication purposes based on existing database entries.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a file exists in the database.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file from the database.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to a file in the database, inserting or updating as needed.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a file from the database.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of a file stored in the database.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a file's contents in the database.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames a file in the database.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies a file within the database.
